title: Warp-bubble shapes that need less energy
question: Are there other shapes that cost less energy? I seem to remember a white paper on that, send a research agent out for that paper, please. (Asked after a smoke test computed the energy of a spherical Alcubierre bubble with radius R = 100 m.)
notes: 2026-09-29: A single researcher run by hand, outside the pipeline; its sources were never checked.
2026-09-29: RS-05 was corrected by hand after rendering White's slide; its values were read off the plot by eye.
2026-09-29: RS-03 (White's JBIS version) rests on a search summary, and RS-13's 'two orders of magnitude' was not checked against the paper's text.
2026-09-29: calc/wall_thickness.py section 2 uses a wrong tidal measure; calc/interior_tides.py computes the tidal tensor correctly.
